items.t: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
items.d: RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. To the AI doomers, RSI represents the cataclysm from which there is no return.
items.fullText: While much attention has focused on the updated financials Anthropic revealed in its revised S-1A on Monday, (revenue is soaring, but so are expenses), the AI lab dropped another little bombshell in the fine print. The filing seems to warn that the company is on the cusp of creating a model capable of recursive self-improvement (RSI). RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. To the AI doomers, RSI represents the cataclysm from which there is no return, in which AI builds itself into something powerful enough that it slips beyond human control and may be indifferent to the damage it causes while achieving its goals. To AI enthusiasts, RSI, or some version of AI reliably using itself to improve, represents the technology’s promise, where it becomes a tool of unimaginable productivity, scientific discovery, and more. Anthropic seems to believe that RSI is both a promise and a peril. It says in the S-1 that it uses AI in its R&D, but it cautions: “Using AI to help build more capable AI could also pose a considerable safety risk, particularly if it sharply accelerates the pace of progress. This is one of the areas covered by our Responsible Scaling Policy, which sets out our plans to monitor and mitigate the risks as we approach what has been termed ‘recursive self-improvement.’” When the term RSI became popular earlier this year , many believed it was a buzzword or, at best, a goal too hard to achieve, define, or prove. New York Times and other outlets sue web browser Brave over alleged content scraping
items.d: The New York Times is suing privacy-focused web browser company Brave for allegedly scraping the outlet’s copyrighted content and unlawfully distributing it to its own customers, like Anthropic and Perplexity.
items.fullText: In Brief Posted: 11:19 AM PST · November 2, 2026 Image Credits: Rafael Henrique/SOPA Images/LightRocket / Getty Images Rebecca Bellan New York Times and other outlets sue web browser Brave over alleged content scraping The New York Times sued Brave, the 11-year-old, privacy-focused browser company, on Monday, alleging it scraped the outlet’s copyrighted content and unlawfully distributed it to customers the suit names as Anthropic, Perplexity, Mistral, xAI, and Cohere. Separately on Monday, the Daily News, the Chicago Tribune, and the Orlando Sentinel filed a similar lawsuit. Both were brought in federal court in Manhattan. The New York Times, which has also sued OpenAI and Perplexity over similar claims, likens Brave to a “supplier, dealer, and distributor of stolen copyrighted content” for AI companies. “In this way, Brave acts both like a burglar that misappropriates the content of publishers, and an AI ‘fence’ that sells stolen content to third parties,” the suit reads. It says Brave built an index of more than 30 billion web pages using an unidentified crawler, leaving publishers unable to block it. The suit also targets a Brave browser feature that bypasses paywalls and the company’s practice of blocking publishers’ ads while selling its own. Founded in 2015, Brave has raised roughly $250 million to date, according to private-market trackers. The Times seeks an injunction and damages. Brave did not immediately respond to a request for comment. items.t: OpenAI is finally merging ChatGPT’s Chat and Work tabs
items.d: OpenAI said that ChatGPT and Codex will draw usage from the same allocation pool after this change.
items.fullText: In Brief Posted: 5:57 AM PST · November 2, 2026 Image Credits: Samuel Boivin/NurPhoto / Getty Images Ivan Mehta OpenAI is finally merging ChatGPT’s Chat and Work tabs The ChatGPT desktop app can be a confusing piece of software, given that there are ChatGPT and Codex sections, and within the former, there are Chat and Work tabs. With so many options, it’s sometimes easy to forget where you are working and where exactly your project is. In an apparent effort to address this, OpenAI is now gearing up to merge the Chat and Work tabs within the ChatGPT experience, according to an email sent to users. OpenAI said that initially, this experience will be available to select users for feedback before it is rolled out widely. “This will enable you to move from exploring an idea to having ChatGPT carry it through, all in one place. You can bring in your files and plugins and ask ChatGPT to build a website, create a presentation, or do things for you on the web, while reviewing and guiding its work. Codex will remain a separate experience in the ChatGPT desktop app,” the email said. OpenAI also said with this transition, both ChatGPT and Codex will draw tokens from the same allowance pool. It said this change won’t impact most users, but based on usage and model, some folks might need to wait for resets more frequently. Rival Anthropic merged Claude’s chat and Cowork functions into one screen in September. items.fullText: 삼성, 샘 올트먼과 ‘AI 혁신’ 간담회 개최 ‘AI Driven’ 경영 강화… 전사적 AX 추진 가속 2026/10/31 AI 요약 새로운 뉴스룸 AI 기능을 살펴보세요! 닫기 --> AUDIO Play Download 공유 레이어 열기 인쇄하기 삼성, 샘 올트먼 CEO 초청해 AI 시대 미래 경영 전략 논의 삼성은 31일 경기도 용인 삼성인력개발원에서 삼성전자 등 주요 관계사 사장단을 대상으로 샘 올트먼(Sam Altman) OpenAI CEO 초청 간담회를 개최했다. 이날 간담회에는 전자·금융·바이오 등 삼성 관계사 사장단 50여 명이 참석했으며, 샘 올트먼 CEO와 함께 ‘AI가 바꿀 다음 10년, 기업의 선택’을 주제로 진행됐다. 삼성 사장단과 샘 올트먼 CEO는 AI 기술의 발전 방향과 활용 가능성을 살펴보고, 이를 바탕으로 새롭게 형성될 시장과 사업 기회에 대한 의견을 나눴다. 또한 AI가 기업의 의사결정과 조직 운영에 미칠 영향을 짚어보며, 새로운 경영 환경에서 경영진이 갖춰야 할 역량에 대해서도 소통했다. 삼성은 전사적 AX 추진을 위한 사장단 교육의 일환으로 경영진의 AI 이해도를 높이고 미래 경영 전략을 모색하기 위해 이번 간담회를 마련했다. 삼성은 글로벌 AI 혁신을 주도하는 OpenAI의 CEO를 초청하는 등 AI 시대의 변화에 선제적으로 대응하고 미래 경쟁력을 강화하는 데 힘을 쏟고 있다. AI 시대의 경쟁력이 경영진의 판단력과 실행력에서 비롯된다는 인식 아래, 사장단이 앞장서 AI를 배우고 활용하는 문화를 확산시키고 있다. 삼성전자와 OpenAI는 지난해 10월 글로벌 AI 인프라 구축을 위한 협력 의향서(LOI)를 체결하고, OpenAI의 스타게이트 프로젝트에 필요한 메모리 반도체 공급을 추진해 왔다. 당시 삼성SDS는 AI 데이터센터 구축과 기업용 AI 서비스 분야에서 협력하기로 했으며, 삼성물산과 삼성중공업은 해상 부유식 데이터센터 공동 개발을 진행하기로 했다. 올해 7월에는 이재용 삼성전자 회장이 미국 샌프란시스코 OpenAI 본사를 방문하는 등 양사 간 교류도 지속해 왔다. 삼성 사장단, 지난 6월에 이어 생성형 AI 집중교육 추가 진행 삼성 사장단은 이날 샘 올트먼 CEO와의 간담회에 앞서 생성형 AI 실습 교육을 진행했다. 지난 6월 사장단을 대상으로 첫 AI 집중교육을 실시한 데 이어, 4개월 만에 시행된 추가 교육이다. 삼성은 사장단부터 AI 기술을 직접 익히고 업무에 적용할 수 있도록 교육 프로그램을 지속 운영하고 있으며, 이를 실제 활용할 수 있는 능력을 높이는 데 초점을 맞췄다. 사장단은 흩어진 경영 자료를 AI로 정리해 자신만의 ‘지식저장소’를 구성하고, 의사결정에 AI를 활용하는 역량을 높였다. 삼성, ‘AI Driven’ 경영 본격화… 전사적 AI 대전환 추진 삼성은 지난 6월부터 연구개발에서 생산·마케팅·지원 업무까지 전 분야에 AI를 도입하는 ‘AI 대전환’을 본격 추진하고 있다. AI를 활용해 업무 생산성과 사업 경쟁력을 높이고, 제품과 서비스는 물론 기업 운영 전반에 AI를 접목해 나갈 계획이다. 이를 위해 관계사별 사업 특성과 업무 환경에 맞는 AI 활용 방안을 마련하고, 임직원들이 AI를 적극적으로 활용할 수 있는 기반을 확대하고 있다. 지난 6월 사장단 교육을 시작으로 약 2,300명의 임원을 대상으로 교육을 추진했으며, 교육 대상을 일반 직원까지 확대해 2027년 2월까지 전 임직원 대상 AI 교육을 완료한다는 목표를 제시했다. 삼성은 관계사별 AI 전담조직을 구축하고, 외부 생성형 AI 서비스의 업무 활용도 확대하고 있다. AI 전담조직은 각 회사의 사업 특성에 맞는 AX 전략을 수립하고, 데이터와 AI 모델의 운영 및 활용을 지원하는 역할을 한다. 삼성은 앞으로 AI 기술의 발전과 산업 환경 변화에 선제적으로 대응하는 한편, 관계사별 AX 추진 성과를 지속 점검하고 실행 과제를 구체화해 AI 중심의 경영 체계를 정착시

items.fullText: Things That Go Beep in the Night: Agentic AI Joins the Search for Extraterrestrial Signals Scientists at the Allen Telescope Array have integrated the NVIDIA Holoscan platform to search for signals that may come from aliens — or the AI they built. October 30, 2026 by Chris Porter 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! While science fiction lore tells us that humans will meet extraterrestrial life in the form of little green men, the detail that should raise hairs this Halloween is this: the search for extraterrestrial intelligence took a major leap forward with AI, and it increasingly focuses on AI agents built by humans listening for AI agents built by aliens. Some scientists have suggested that extraterrestrial civilizations, if they exist, could be billions of years older than humanity. Such civilizations might have developed technologies far beyond humanity’s, including forms of AI. Breakthrough Listen and the SETI Institute are bringing agentic AI into the daily search for extraterrestrial intelligence. At the Allen Telescope Array in Northern California, agents can now steer the instrument, enhance and correct incoming data, and apply AI models to the incoming stream — all from a single natural language request. The NVIDIA Holoscan platform processes the massive streams of sensor data, giving agents live data to act on. The result is a faster, more adaptable search for potential signals from extraterrestrial life and technologies. “As our new agentic observatories reach out into the universe, what they find may have much more in common with themselves than with the humans who created them,” said Andrew Siemion, Bernard M. Oliver chair for SETI at the SETI Institute and principal investigator of Breakthrough Listen. “But this isn’t something to fear. Developers are combining frontier AI models with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to help carry out that work — building applications for exploring scenarios, investigating failures and improving designs. Developers direct AI agents through natural-language instructions, review results and guide changes. Omniverse libraries provide GPU-accelerated physics, rendering and sensor simulation capabilities. Omniverse brings together real-to-sim tools and agent skills to help developers turn real-world captures into editable starting environments for physical AI simulation. David Wehr, from NVIDIA’s simulation technology team, built on that work using Astra to develop a workflow for digitally reconstructing a building without its contents. The goal is an editable, simulation-ready building model where developers can add or reposition shelving and machinery to evaluate warehouse layouts and automation plans before making physical changes. items.fullText: NVIDIA Transforms European Retail, From Digital Discovery to Physical Operations October 21, 2026 by Mavi Nafria 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! European retailers are using open models and physical intelligence across use cases — from a commerce platform cutting inference costs by 90% to to a fulfillment center where collaboration of different robotic fleets is simulated inside a digital twin. Frontier Results With Open Models Retail leaders and technology companies across Europe are using NVIDIA-accelerated open and frontier models to advance agentic commerce, digital product discovery and retail R&D. Shopify post-trains open models to reach frontier-level accuracy at a fraction of the cost. Its engineers use the NVIDIA Megatron Bridge library for faster fine-tuning and NVIDIA NeMo RL for reinforcement learning. Shopify has post-trained NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for the GraphQL subagent integrated into Sidekick, Shopify’s AI assistant for merchants. The subagent retrieves store data for several Sidekick features, including Sidekick Pulse, which researches a merchant’s store and recommends ways to improve it. items.fullText: NVIDIA Cloud Partners Scale Across Europe — Sovereign, Open and Built for Safe AI Agents Growing ecosystem of AI clouds across Europe, Nordics, Africa and Central Asia build full-stack NVIDIA DSX Vera Rubin AI factories as AI-native companies drive demand for sovereign compute, training, inference and post-training services. October 21, 2026 by Stuart Pitts 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Demand from AI-natives is pulling the European AI cloud ecosystem forward faster than ever. Developers need compute closer to their data, open models they can customize and serve at scale, and full-stack infrastructure that is secure by design. NVIDIA Cloud Partners across Europe, the Nordics, Africa, and Central Asia are expanding regional compute capacity for model training and inference, helping developers build agentic and physical AI applications, and establishing boundaries around what agents can access and do. Together, they’re turning Europe’s energy, data, research and industrial expertise into productive intelligence — supporting new models, applications, organizations and jobs while giving people more control over where and how they develop and deploy AI.
